title: Hearing his father play only a few times; Ratty and Man Vigne
summary: Arthur heard his father in cabarets only five or six times, as a boy bringing him lunch; half brother Man was a drummer.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Is there anything else that you can tell us about this band, the Peerless band, or when they rehearsed, or anything that you can remember around the house, or did you ever get to go to their dances before they...

Well no, I never did go to their dances. I think I seen my daddy play probably, maybe six or seven times in those cabarets, go to bring him something, you know, over there, and I'd go in while I was... Those people knew me, you know, from around there, bringing his lunch and everything. And I was a small kid, I could get in there, and I've gotten there several times at night, and I was at the shop with him, working around there, cutting killing or something for him, and I'd probably go bring him something at the shop. I seen, heard him play, you know, off and on, not too many times. I doubt if it's six times that I heard him play. That is on the job, but around the house and rehearsals, I've heard him play a lot, but I mean in fuels, but I mean in those nightclubs, I've heard him play only about maybe five or six times I went to those places, you know. He was playing in a place on Liberty Street, they had a nightclub there, and he was playing in there. And I went there several times and heard him play there, but I mean I didn't hear too much of these music and dances because I was too small, I didn't go to dances, my brothers and them probably did, but I didn't.
Who was Ratty Fiend, was he, Ratty Fiend, was he related to you?

Ratty Fiend, they call him, that's the fellow you're speaking about, they must be talking about man. He was the drummer, he was the drummer, man fiend, that's who that is. In front of your half brother.

Yeah, yeah. Excuse me just a minute. Yes. Sure. Remember the last band, the very latest ones that your father worked with? You have been about twelve years old, it would be hard to remember. Yeah, I don't remember the last band.
